data.name: Wattson the Bulb
data.detailed_description:
About This Game
Awaken as a tiny bulb in a strange, beautiful, and hostile world. You remember nothing—only a spark of curiosity and the instinct to survive. As you explore, you’ll recover fragments of your past, master a growing arsenal of abilities, and learn to combine them in creative ways to outsmart enemies, outmaneuver hazards, and open paths you didn’t even know existed.
Built around tight, responsive platforming and layered exploration, this metroidvania challenges you to chart your own route through over a hundred hand-crafted stages. Whether you’re a speedrunner hunting for the perfect line or an explorer methodically unveiling every secret, a tough—but fair—adventure awaits.


Key Features
A unique hero with a forgotten past: Guide a sentient bulb on a journey of self-discovery, piecing together who you were—and who you’ll become—through exploration and play.
10+ unlockable abilities: Dash across chasms, grapple to new heights, wall-climb, reshape your size to slip through tight spaces, conjure platforms, and more. Each power is simple to learn and satisfying to master.
Ability combos that reward creativity: Chain moves together to invent your own solutions. Convert a near-miss into momentum, link grapples into aerial routes, or combine size-shifts with movement tech to break through seemingly impossible challenges.
100+ hand-crafted levels: Every area is designed to teach, test, and tempt—shortcuts for the bold, secrets for the curious, and clean routes for those chasing gold.
5+ themed biomes: From neon cityscapes and eerie laboratories to alien cliffs, starlit voids, and slime-soaked caverns, each biome introduces fresh twists, hazards, and surprises.

Multiple playstyles supported:
Explore at your own pace to unlock every upgrade and secret.
Or speed through, mastering routes and shaving seconds off your best times.
Challenging but fair: Tight checkpoints, readable hazards, and crisp controls make even the hardest sections feel achievable with practice.
Secrets and optional trials: Hidden passages, high-risk time trials, and collectible passages reward mastery without blocking your main path.
Controller-first feel: Built for gamepads with snappy input and clean readability. Keyboard play is supported as well.

The World
The world is bizarre yet cohesive: a patchwork of biomes stitched together by long-forgotten machinery and organic growth. City ruins loom over shimmering laboratories; wind-scoured cliffs give way to subterranean slime nests and star-dusted vistas. Every zone layers new mechanics and visual storytelling on top of your growing toolkit, inviting you to revisit past areas with fresh eyes and newfound skills.

Progression You Can Feel
Learn, don’t just level: Your strength is defined by knowledge—of routes, of timing, and of your abilities. Each upgrade opens both obvious doors and subtle techniques.
Meaningful unlocks: Every ability changes how you move and think, encouraging inventive solutions and enabling elegant, high-skill routes.
Non-linear paths: Multiple ways forward, optional challenges, and plenty of reasons to return to earlier zones with a stronger kit.
Built for Skimming—and Depth
Jump in quickly: Early levels teach by doing, with clear signposting and intuitive hazard design.
Mastery at the top end: Advanced tech and clever ability chains let experts express skill and creativity in spectacular ways.

Visuals and Feel
Crisp, readable art: Environments and hazards are designed for clarity at speed.
Distinct biomes: Each area is instantly recognizable, with new platforming concepts and ambient storytelling.
Satisfying feedback: Snappy movement, responsive air control, and punchy audio cues make every success feel earned.
Perfect for Speedrunners and Explorers
Speedrunner-friendly routes: Clean lines, advanced skips (if you can pull them off), and time-focused challenges.
Completionist bliss: Hidden rooms, ability-gated secrets, and collectible routes that reward thorough exploration.
Accessibility and Options
Play your way: Tweak difficulty-related options, adjust visuals and audio, and configure controls to suit your preferences.
Fair checkpoints: Practice tricky sections without losing long stretches of progress.

data.short_description: A metroidvania platformer set in a bizarre world. Master unique abilities and combine them in creative ways to overcome challenges over a hundred hand crafted levels. Speed through to find the fastest route or explore at your own pace to unlock everything — a tough but rewarding adventure awaits.
